name: @sos-2/provenance
description: SOS 2.0 Provenance: producer records (tool, model+version, command, environment), exact source/deployment revisions, time windows and context, verifiable provenance chains (broken chains reported as UNKNOWN, never silently truncated), preservation of the underlying source availability, and non-authoritative LLM provenance (spec/architecture.md sections 5 and 18; requirements R9, R22, R30).
